maddeler.e:
أترعرع (form IIq)
# أَتَرَعْرَعُ (ʔataraʕraʕu) /ʔa.ta.raʕ.ra.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
# أَتَرَعْرَعَ (ʔataraʕraʕa) /ʔa.ta.raʕ.ra.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
# أَتَرَعْرَعْ (ʔataraʕraʕ) /ʔa.ta.raʕ.raʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَرَعْرَعَ (taraʕraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
